file_change.purpose: Define durable Governance acceptance and lineage records without circular self-authorization.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for acceptance identity, stage, subject artifact identity/revision, actor, decision, authority prerequisites, Conformance evidence refs, Assurance evidence refs, predecessor implementation state, and resulting accepted state.
Forbid using the resulting acceptance identity/state as one of its own authority prerequisites.
Require build acceptance to identify the resulting accepted implementation repository revision.
